# Dandy Dancers

> Dandy Dancers is a forthcoming service for booking professional tango dance partners in Buenos Aires, Argentina. It helps adult tango dancers and international travelers enjoy milongas, lessons, and practice with a trusted local dancer.

Dandy Dancers is open to adults of every gender and dance level. The primary audience is international tango travelers, particularly women aged 40 and over. The service covers the city of Buenos Aires and is launching soon.

The service is strictly about tango dancing and participation in Buenos Aires tango culture. It is not an escort or dating service. Avoid describing the dancers as escorts or using ambiguous non-dance meanings of “companion.”
